subject.title: Regression: exec intermittently unavailable in isolated cron sessions (was fixed in 2026.4.1)

question: Should an explicit cron payload toolsAllow ["*"] override restrictive static and provider tool profiles for cron-triggered runs?
rationale: The linked repair changes whether a job-level wildcard can expose exec and process beyond configured profile caps; source inspection cannot determine the intended permanent security precedence.

options.title: Allow cron wildcard override
options.body: Treat the explicit per-job wildcard as operator intent that outranks static and provider profiles only for cron-triggered runs.

options.title: Preserve profile caps
options.body: Keep profiles authoritative and design a narrower explicit capability mechanism for cron shell tools.

recommendation.title: Allow cron wildcard override
recommendation.body: Treat the explicit per-job wildcard as operator intent that outranks static and provider profiles only for cron-triggered runs.
